required_fixes: Rewrite claim ceiling to make relative-to-null semantics explicit: state that observed log BF is NEGATIVE (-10.4 to -15.6 nats) at K=12, so M0 memory-only is favored absolutely; C3 'detection' is separation from an even-more-negative shuffled null, not evidence for action-conditioned dynamics beyond (url_before, H_K2). Do not present SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST as bridging synthetic->real for C-WEB-DYNAMICS without this qualification. Evidence: result.json metrics.variants.*.per_alpha_log_bayes_factor_nats.observed negative, validity_notes[2], report.md section 5.

Correct effective replication count: acknowledge that {vanillajs,react,svelte} are bit-identical and {vue,angular} are bit-identical under identical 24-action protocol (raw_results.json variants, CTRL_VARIANT_ISOMORPHISM). Effective independent hash-SPA replications =2, not 5. A future test must use variant-diverse protocols or distinct FSMs to claim 5/5.

Justify or preregister action-variable resolution: prereg.md states Action = URL of action target (action.target_href) but NL subset has action_target=None on all 80 records per variant (result.json observations[1], CTRL_DEGENERATE_ACTION_TARGET), making that encoding degenerate (log BF=0). Producer used action_primitive instead, matching PMI parent EXP-PHYSICS-35262258744. Freeze a single action definition in spec.json before counting C1/C3; do not carry a degenerate definition into the decision rule.

Test sensitivity to K: frozen K=12 over-penalizes observed state cardinality S=3-4 (validity_notes[4]), making BF magnitudes incomparable to synthetic 12-state setting where K matches n_states. Re-run data-matched K in {3,4,5} as exploratory sensitivity analysis before any C-WEB-DYNAMICS claim; report how absolute BF sign and C1/C3 change.

Reconcile B1 baseline discrepancy before any gating use: this run B1 I(url_after;action|url_before)=0.0581-0.0716 bits vs parent-cited 0.188-0.209 bits (result.json metrics.baselines.B1_url_only_conditional_mi_bits, unresolved[2]). Clarify computation scope (Laplace over (y,a) at each x vs parent) and confirm null handling.

Do not claim N=5000-scale validation: achieved N_NL=80 per variant (112 valid of 144 raw, 32 link leakages) vs frozen target N=5000 (spec.json measurement_validity, result.json variants.*.n_nl). Retain bounded ceiling: TodoMVC hash-SPA, 6 scripted sessions, near-deterministic FSM (det_ratio 0.846-0.944). Generalization to stochastic, history-dependent, or production SPAs untested.

validity_findings.finding: Positive control replication-exact: synthetic 12-state stochastic SPA N=5000 reproduces parent EXP-PHYSICS-35578258358 exactly (observed 643.09/338.67/167.90 nats, null_median -78.36/-130.91/-116.10, p=0.0005 at all alphas). C6 PASS validates estimator implementation.

C1 and C3 technically pass frozen thresholds on all variants/alphas (null_median -24.8 to -39.7 nats <0, observed -10.4 to -15.6 nats exceeds all 1999 null samples => p=0.0005 floor). Recomputed observed BF via independent Dirichlet-Multinomial code matches producer bit-identically (vanillajs alpha 1.0 -11.537420435660863, vue alpha 1.0 -15.505944768691677). Decision rule formally yields SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (C1 5/5, C3 5/5, C5 5/5, C6 pass).

Observed BF negative on all 15 (variant x alpha) cells: memory-only M0 favored absolutely at K=12. Per-stratum decomposition (vanillajs alpha 1.0: '#/'->'#/' -9.68, '#/completed'->'#/completed' -2.15; stochastic strata +0.30/+0.56) shows penalty from deterministic strata dominates. This contradicts any absolute claim of action-conditioned web dynamics beyond memory.

Relative separation is real but mechanistic interpretation is confounded: null is even more negative because within-session shuffling mixes outcomes inside deterministic K2 cells (85-94% deterministic strata, B2=1.0). Null negativity is a design consequence of deterministic FSM + K=12 penalty, not evidence of null proper centering for stochastic dynamics. C1 (<0) is therefore trivially satisfied and not discriminating.

validity_findings.finding: Near-deterministic environment cannot express the tested effect beyond memory: B2 action-history K3 accuracy 1.0 and K2 determinism 0.846-0.944 mean (url_before, H_K2) already determines url_after for 85-94% of strata. The environment is a 3-4 state deterministic FSM, so I(url_after; action | url_before, H_K2) is near zero by construction. Test is valid for detecting generic action signal beyond history, but failure to find positive BF is not informative about stochastic/production SPAs.

Sampling shortfall: target N=5000 per variant, achieved N_NL=80 (6 sessions x 24 raw =144, 112 valid after error filtering, 32 leakages). 1.6% of target; effective independent transitions further reduced by 6 near-identical scripted sessions (timestamps sequential, same 7-step cycle). Spec explicitly allowed reporting actual N, so not a spec violation, but power and history diversity are severely limited.

claim_ceiling: Maximum justified: Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial (K=12, alpha_prior 0.5/1.0/2.0, state-history K2=(url_before +2 prev URLs)) is correctly implemented (positive control replication-exact) and, on TodoMVC hash-SPA fragment-aware URL states, shows valid null centering (shuffled null median -24.8 to -39.7 nats <0) and relative separation where observed log BF (-10.4 to -15.6 nats) exceeds all 1999 within-session shuffled-action null samples (p=0.0005 floor) on 2 effectively independent deterministic FSM types (4-state {vanillajs,react,svelte} and 3-state {vue,angular}) with 80 NL transitions each (6 scripted sessions). Observed BF is NEGATIVE, so memory-only M0 is favored absolutely at K=12; this is NOT evidence for action-conditioned Web dynamics beyond memory on these sites, but evidence that the real action arrangement is less penalized than random shuffling inside deterministic cells. Ceiling EXCLUDES: C-WEB-DYNAMICS beyond this relative null separation, production SPAs, stochastic or history-dependent dynamics, richer state representations (DOM, a11y, visual), data-matched K, title-aware PMI, and any product promotion. Generalization to N=5000-scale, diverse-session, or non-deterministic settings untested.

Generalization to non-TodoMVC, non-deterministic, stateful (non-URL-representable), or history-dependent production SPAs (todo count, filter state, localStorage) where DOM/DOM+history carries signal beyond URL - untested.

Identifiability argument from spec (action adds information beyond memory) is not satisfied in this near-deterministic setting; beyond-memory dynamics untested.
